With over 25 million Americans living with rare diseases, it is essential that Congress continues to support funding for research.
 
The FDA has approved over 800 drugs and products, but millions of Americans still suffer from ailments that have no treatment. #RareDiseaseDay

Americans have a constitutional right to keep and bear arms, and no disaster or emergency declared by bureaucrats can circumvent that right. I will fight any attempt by this Administration to make an end run around the Constitution. https://t.co/tJbvYhZefZ

The Protecting the Right to Keep and Bear Arms Act would prohibit officials from using the term “public health emergency” as a pretext for gun-control tactics. It takes its name from the amendment that has guaranteed this right for centuries. #WickerReport https://t.co/JaH61svXd8
Last week, I met with the CEO of Highland Hills Medical Center in Tate County to discuss proposed improvements and patient care. https://t.co/v3cW7mLaIG
Rural health care providers deliver care to 61 million Americans. I joined my colleagues in a resolution designating today #NationalRuralHealthDay to thank them for their service.

Last week I met with Mississippi’s Stars of Life Paramedics. They have been recognized by the American Ambulance Association for their outstanding service as emergency medical providers. https://t.co/E2dQydsPhc

Over 1/3 of Mississippians are suffering from obesity, but we can make changes to combat this epidemic. I cosponsored the Treat and Reduce Obesity Act to expand coverage for Medicare recipients and help Americans live a healthier life.

Closing our rural-urban healthcare gap will require tailored solutions designed by those who know their communities best – local leaders.

This bill empowers them to make decisions they believe are best for their towns while rejecting the Biden admin’s one-size-fits-all approach.
